notes: Hypothesis: learn selective per-packet switching toward the alternative expert only when it corrects the clean-teacher pseudo-label and the selected anchor does not. Previous shared selector minimized distributional KL and tended to collapse to the weaker expert on WiSig; bounded frequency changes had no reliable paired improvement.

Source-U teacher pseudo-label is argmax F(clean). Label switch=1 if only the other expert matches it; label 0 when anchor matches, including both correct; ignore both-wrong examples. BCE negative examples weighted 2, plus 0.5 clean-input no-switch BCE. Both datasets use identical loss and threshold logit >=0. Head starts at bias -2 and defaults to anchor.

Frozen LoRa W24 E104 / WiSig Tri-SIG-TIME SSL F0 original default heads provide 12000/72000 source sample forwards; no U TX ground truth, V, target or classifier gradients in training. LoRa real-gain parent retains guided and pseudo-label ancestry. All parent costs extra.

LoRa fixed real-gain and WiSig fixed R17 defaults were chosen from repeatedly exposed source V. Architecture and method shared, weights independently trained. The same V data also informed this candidate design; it is development evidence, not a blind screen.

1000 source U updates, seed 2026112957, same generator and existing low-urban/clean paired controls and per-half thresholds. Any candidate pass requires additional preregistered source replication before formal target testing.
